audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart was wrong on six of seven rows and contradicted its own prose: it gave Aurora Level 1 at 7/10 while the whys text says Pantheon's stun-into-spear beats her single level-1 spell, and gave Pantheon the first-item and two-item stages while the prose says he flattens into items.
audit.why: Shield Vault is a targeted 600-range dash-stun on 13/12/11/10/9s and Aurora has no Across the Veil until she ranks it (22/21/20/19/18s), so Levels 1-2 are his. Levels 3 and 4-5 are genuinely even once Twofold Hex and The Weirding are up but Aegis Assault can still block the poke. From 6 and the first AP item Aurora is ahead; at two items Grand Starfall's 180s global re-opens the game for him, so that stage is even.
audit.corrected: Chart set as one atomic group to Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Aurora / Aurora / Skill, matching the packet chart, the 48.86% win rate and the mirror audit in audits/top/pantheon__aurora.json. Ratings realigned to 3/3/5/5/7/7/5.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carried no cooldowns and the level-6 line named 'Between the Worlds', which is not an ability.
audit.why: Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds. Pantheon's real spike shape is level 2 (Shield Vault plus empowered Comet Spear), then a fall-off into items, with Grand Starfall on 180/165/150s as a global map spike rather than a duelling one.
audit.corrected: Stage text now names Between Worlds, Aegis Assault's 22s and Grand Starfall's 180s global.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability name 'Spear Shot (Q)' for Pantheon in early, whys[0], spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0]; and the decisive interaction was never stated.
audit.why: Pantheon's Q is Comet Spear (575 range). The interaction that decides the lane is that Shield Vault is TARGETED: Across the Veil makes Aurora invisible on landing, which breaks its target lock. The range gap is the other half — Twofold Hex reaches 900, Comet Spear 575.
audit.corrected: Every 'Spear Shot' replaced with Comet Spear; the invisibility-breaks-target-lock interaction and the 900-vs-575 range gap now appear in the trading, cooldown and do's lines.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block said only 'matchup-defining' and 'track it'.
audit.why: Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9s, Aegis Assault 22/21/20/19/18s, Grand Starfall 180/165/150s, Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18s are all in the kit files.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in, including that Shield Vault (13s) comes back faster than Across the Veil (22s).

audit.why: Aegis Assault is flagged as a channel, and champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json claims Between Worlds cancels it outright. Riot's Between Worlds description contains no stun, knockup or interrupt — only damage, a slow and a traversable zone. The mirror audit reached the same conclusion.
audit.corrected: Deliberately NOT written. Left the existing text alone and logged the claim as unverified.

edits.before: Pantheon owns these levels and you have to respect it — his point-click Shield Vault (W) stun into an empowered Spear Shot (Q) is a real all-in that lands before Spirit Abjuration has stacked enough healing to carry a trade. Do not step up to throw a Twofold Hex he can answer by stunning you mid-animation, and watch his Aegis Assault (E): when he holds it toward you it eats your Q and autos from that direction, so a face-up trade does less than you think. Last-hit at the very tip of your Q, eat a little spear poke, and just survive to level 4 — your sustain wins the long game, not the level-2 fight.

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/pantheon__aurora.json supplied Shield Vault 13s / 600 targeted, Comet Spear 575 vs Twofold Hex 900, and the invisibility-breaks-target-lock finding. Sides here are the exact inverse of that file and both now agree Pantheon owns Levels 1-2 and Aurora owns 6 and first item. Three claims in the existing Aurora text I could NOT verify from Riot's data and therefore left untouched rather than amplifying: (a) Between Worlds granting untargetability (the description says damage, slow and a traversable zone only), (b) Across the Veil resetting on takedown (no reset in the description), (c) dontsFull[1] 'Sit low for his W execute' — Pantheon's execute, if any, belongs to Comet Spear not Shield Vault, and no execute appears in Riot's text at all, so I left that don't entry alone. It should probably be rewritten or dropped by someone who can confirm it. Also note _missing-interactions.json's 'Between Worlds cancels Aegis Assault' claim, which I did not write.
